_comment: === TEST FILE: All 4 check types, each appearing multiple times ===
HORIZON: 20 days.  Only station C has maintenance capacity (cap=4).
Thresholds:
A : flight-hour threshold = 1 200 min (20 h),  duration =   360 min
B : flight-hour threshold = 3 600 min (60 h),  duration = 2 880 min (2 days)
C : calendar-day threshold =  10 days,         duration = 1 440 min (1 day)
D : calendar-day threshold =  14 days,         duration = 2 880 min (2 days)
Aircraft roles (5 aircraft, AC4 starts at C):
AC0 -- 2x A-check (flight-hour triggered, thresh=1200 min):
A_init=1000 min.  1 flight (200 min) brings cumulative to 1200 min
-> F01 (B->C, day 1) triggers 1st A-check.  Counter resets.
AC0 then does 3 full round-trips (days 2-4), each 400 min (B->C + C->B):
round-trip 1 (day 2): F08 B->C + F09 C->B  (400 min; z blocked by c8 since
F09 departs within the A-check window of F08)
round-trip 2 (day 3): F10 B->C + F11 C->B  (same, z blocked)
round-trip 3 (day 4): F13 B->C (trigger!) + F15 C->B (dep > arr+360).
After round-trips 1&2: cumulative = 400+400 = 800 min.
F13 adds 200 min -> total 1000. F15 adds 200 -> total 1200 = threshold.
Wait -- the 2nd A-check must be triggered by an FM (B->C) flight.
c13 pair (d=1,d_=4): t_sum = 6*200 = 1200 min = threshold.
Constraint 1 (relax by mega[0,1,A]=1 from 1st check): satisfied.
Constraint 2 (relax by mega[0,4,A]=1 from 2nd check): satisfied.
c8 for F13: same-day C->B return F15 departs at 5100 > 4700+360=5060
-> NOT in same-day-block -> z[13,0,4,A]=1 allowed -> 2nd A-check day 4.
C->B returns F09, F11 depart within check window so c8 blocks those triggers.
Starts at B.
AC1 -- 1x B-check then 1x A-check (two flight-hour types on one aircraft):
B_init=3400 min (200 below 3600 threshold).
F05 (B->C, day 2): B_accum=3400+200=3600 -> B-check day 2 (2880 min).
A_init=800 min.  After F05: A_accum(horizon)=200.  After F14(C->B): 400.
F16 (B->C, day 5): triggers A-check (c13b forces mega[1,5,A]=1).
Return F17 dep=6400 > arr(F16)+360=6020+360=6380 -> NOT blocked by c8.
Starts at B.
AC2 -- 2x C-check (calendar-day, thresh=10 days, dur=1440 min):
C_Days_init=9 -> remaining=1 day -> c12b forces check on day 1.
F02 (B->C, day 1, arr=380) triggers 1st C-check.
c12 sliding window (10 days): window [2..11] must contain a check.
F18 (B->C, day 10) triggers 2nd C-check.
Starts at B.
AC3 -- 2x D-check (calendar-day, thresh=14 days, dur=2880 min):
D_Days_init=13 -> remaining=1 day -> c12b forces check on day 1.
F03 (B->C, day 1, arr=440) triggers 1st D-check.
c12 sliding window (14 days, horizon 20): window [2..15] must have a check.
F20 (B->C, day 14) triggers 2nd D-check.
Starts at B.
AC4 -- free aircraft at C, one operational C->B flight.
Flight schedule (all flights 200 min duration):
F01 B->C dep=   60 arr=  260 (day 1)  [AC0]  1st A-check trigger
F02 B->C dep=  180 arr=  380 (day 1)  [AC2]  1st C-check trigger
F03 B->C dep=  240 arr=  440 (day 1)  [AC3]  1st D-check trigger
F04 C->B dep=  700 arr=  900 (day 1)  [AC0]  post-1st-A-check (700>620)
F05 B->C dep= 1500 arr= 1700 (day 2)  [AC1]  B-check trigger
F06 C->B dep= 1800 arr= 2000 (day 2)  [AC4]  operational
F07 C->B dep= 1860 arr= 2060 (day 2)  [AC2]  post-1st-C-check (1860>1820)
F08 B->C dep= 1920 arr= 2120 (day 2)  [AC0]  accum 1/3 round-trip 1
F09 C->B dep= 2160 arr= 2360 (day 2)  [AC0]  return R1 (2160<2480 -> z blocked)
F10 B->C dep= 3000 arr= 3200 (day 3)  [AC0]  accum 2/3 round-trip 2
F11 C->B dep= 3240 arr= 3440 (day 3)  [AC0]  return R2 (3240<3560 -> z blocked)
F12 C->B dep= 3360 arr= 3560 (day 3)  [AC3]  post-1st-D-check (3360>3320)
F13 B->C dep= 4500 arr= 4700 (day 4)  [AC0]  2nd A-check trigger (6th 200-min)
F14 C->B dep= 4860 arr= 5060 (day 4)  [AC1]  post-B-check (4860>4580)
F15 C->B dep= 5100 arr= 5300 (day 4)  [AC0]  post-2nd-A-check (5100>5060)
F16 B->C dep= 5820 arr= 6020 (day 5)  [AC1]  A-check trigger
F17 C->B dep= 6400 arr= 6600 (day 5)  [AC1]  post-A-check (6400>6380)
F18 B->C dep=13020 arr=13220 (day 10) [AC2]  2nd C-check trigger
F20 B->C dep=18780 arr=18980 (day 14) [AC3]  2nd D-check trigger
Expected MILP output (--no-check-hierarchy):
AC0: A-check day 1 (F01),  A-check day 4 (F13)  -- 2x type A
AC1: B-check day 2 (F05),  A-check day 5 (F16)  -- types B and A
AC2: C-check day 1 (F02),  C-check day 10 (F18) -- 2x type C
AC3: D-check day 1 (F03),  D-check day 14 (F20) -- 2x type D
Run command:
py -3 heu180h.py --mode milp --data inputsABCD/ABCD_multi_check_test.json
--solver cplex --no-check-hierarchy --no-show
